description: This Java class 'PageStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze page-related metrics of books in a reading project. It includes functionalities to find the book with the most pages and calculate the average number of pages for books with known page counts, focusing on the 'read' shelf.

classes.name: PageStatistics
classes.description: A class that computes page-related statistics for books on specific shelves, such as maximum pages and average pages.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the book with the highest number of pages from the read shelf.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLength
methods.description: Calculates the average number of pages for books with a specified page count, returning an Optional<Double>.
